item.title: Federal judge hears arguments on Minnesota’s immigration crackdown after fatal shootings
item.description: A federal judge heard arguments Monday over Minnesota’s challenge to the Trump administration’s immigration enforcement crackdown, posing skeptical questions to both sides about the effort that has led to two fatal shootings by federal officers. The post Federal judge hears arguments on Minnesota’s immigration crackdown after fatal shootings appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Sean Payton’s gamble: The decision that derailed the Broncos’ Super Bowl dreams
item.description: With a blizzard bearing down on Empower Field at Mile High, coach Sean Payton went for the jugular instead of the points, short-circuiting the Denver Broncos’ drive to Super Bowl 60. The post Sean Payton’s gamble: The decision that derailed the Broncos’ Super Bowl dreams appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Education: W, EMCC students come together for leadership retreat
item.description: A cohort of first-generation students from Mississippi University for Women and East Mississippi Community College, members of the Lowndes First-generation Youth Realizing Success Together Leaders, came together at Plymouth Bluff Environmental Center for the 2026 leadership retreat, Jan. 8-9. The post Education: W, EMCC students come together for leadership retreat appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Mississippi shivers under ice as long recovery looms
item.description: Residents in a iced-over swath of Mississippi began to confront the ugly truth Monday as they shivered in ever-colder and darkened houses: Recovery from the state’s worst ice storm in more than 30 years could take a week or more. The post Mississippi shivers under ice as long recovery looms appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Trump says US used secret weapon to disable Venezuelan equipment in Maduro raid
item.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. used a secret weapon he called “The Discombobulator” to disable Venezuelan equipment when the U.S. captured Nicolás Maduro. Trump also renewed his threat to conduct military strikes on land against drug cartels, including in Mexico. The post Trump says US used secret weapon to disable Venezuelan equipment in Maduro raid appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Israel recovers the last hostage’s remains in Gaza. Ceasefire moves into tricky new phase
item.description: Israel said Monday it had recovered the remains of the last hostage in Gaza, closing a painful chapter for the country and clearing the way for the next and more challenging phase of its ceasefire with Hamas. The post Israel recovers the last hostage’s remains in Gaza. Ceasefire moves into tricky new phase appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Iran-backed militias in Iraq and Yemen threaten new attacks as US aircraft carrier arrives
item.description: Two Iranian-backed militias in the Mideast are signaling their willingness to launch new attacks, likely trying to back Iran, as officials acknowledged the arrival of a U.S. aircraft carrier to the region Monday. The post Iran-backed militias in Iraq and Yemen threaten new attacks as US aircraft carrier arrives appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Ole Miss men lose second straight, fall to Kentucky
item.description: Despite a late rally that saw Ole Miss cut its deficit to Kentucky down to two points with 2:48 to play, the Wildcats outscored the Rebels 10-3 over the game’s final 1 minute, 5 seconds in a 72-63 victory at Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky. It’s Ole Miss’ (11-9, 3-4 SEC) second loss in a row. The post Ole Miss men lose second straight, fall to Kentucky appeared first on The Dispatch.
